<thought>Chlorine shows a characteristic M+2 peak at ~33 % of the base peak, matching the observed 278 m/z intensity (33.6 %). The presence of a notable M+1 peak (~16 %) indicates a substantial 13C contribution, confirming carbon. No other element’s isotopic pattern (e.g., Br, S, O, N) matches the observed distribution. Therefore, the definitively identifiable elements are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
